rows.grounds: compound of lalāṭa, varṇa, rāśi, and stha; situated in the forehead-syllable mass
compound of sura and arcita in vocative

items.question: What must be done one hundred thousand times in the forehead-syllable mass for the god-worshipped?
premises: One hundred thousand repetitions are prescribed.
They are situated in the forehead-syllable mass.
The rite is addressed to the god-worshipped.
items.inference: The practitioner must complete one hundred thousand repetitions in the forehead-syllable mass for the worshipped god.
uncertainties: The exact ritual referent of forehead-syllable mass is not specified.
items.plain_english: Having done one hundred thousand [repetitions] situated in the forehead-syllable mass, O god-worshipped.
